name: Band face pull
summary: High pull toward the face for the rear shoulders and upper back.
steps: Anchor the band at face height (door anchor) and step back.
Start with straight arms in front, palms facing down.
Pull toward the face with the elbows high, separating the hands.
breathing: Exhale while pulling, inhale while returning.
easier: Lighter band or step closer to the anchor.
harder: Stronger band or a longer squeeze.
contraindications: Make sure the anchor is secure so the band cannot snap toward the face.

start.alt: Standing, arms straight forward at shoulder height holding a band anchored in front.

end.alt: Standing, hands pulled beside the face with elbows high.
